We need to construct a retrosynthesis route for target SMILES O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied template 20810 to target, got precursors: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F').

So first reaction: target -> two fragments: fragment A (the big heterocycle) and fragment B (sulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl). Next template 2895 applied to fragment A gave nitrated version? Actually we applied to fragment A and got ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1',). That's a single product? Wait apply_template returns list of precursors for retrosynthesis: given molecule, returns possible precursors. For fragment A, applying 2895 gave a precursor with nitro group on aromatic ring. So second reaction: fragment A -> precursor A1 (tert-butyl carbamate piperazine attached to nitro aromatic). Next template 1914397 applied to that gave two fragments: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). So third reaction: nitro aromatic fragment splits into a piperazine carbamate fragment and a brominated aromatic bicyclic fragment.

Next template 1914398 applied to the brominated aromatic fragment gave ('BrBr', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). So fourth reaction: brominated aromatic fragment -> bromine (Br2) and a de-brominated? Actually product is same aromatic with nitro? Wait original had Br substituent; after applying 1914398 we got BrBr and O=[N+]... same core but without Br? Actually the second product is O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2 (nitro aromatic without Br). So fourth reaction splits off Br2.

Next template 1914399 applied to that nitro aromatic core gave ('O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21',). That's a single product? Actually apply_template returns precursors; here we got one precursor which is a lactone? Wait it's a fused ring with nitro. So fifth reaction: the nitro aromatic core -> a precursor (maybe a phenol derivative). Next template 74054 applied to that gave? We haven't applied yet. We need to apply 74054 to the product O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21. Let's apply.
